marketplace.summary: Coordinates reproducible biomedical research from evidence discovery through analysis, validation, and writing.

skills.name: batch-effect-correction
skills.description: Corrects known batch effects in bulk expression matrices while preserving biological groups.

skills.name: biomedical-search-strategy-builder
skills.description: Builds database-specific biomedical literature search strategies.

skills.name: claim-strength-calibrator
skills.description: Aligns manuscript claims with the available evidence and validation level.

skills.name: clinical-question-clarifier
skills.description: Turns broad clinical ideas into bounded and testable research questions.

skills.name: differential-expression-analysis
skills.description: Identifies differentially expressed genes in two-group bulk expression data.

skills.name: discussion-composer
skills.description: Drafts biomedical manuscript discussions from findings, context, and limitations.

skills.name: ena-database
skills.description: Searches and retrieves sequence records and metadata from the European Nucleotide Archive.

skills.name: endpoint-definition-designer
skills.description: Defines operational primary, secondary, and exploratory study endpoints.

skills.name: external-model-validation
skills.description: Validates an existing prognostic signature against an external bulk expression cohort.

skills.name: gene-protein-expression-matrix-normalization
skills.display_name: Gene and Protein Expression Matrix Normalization
skills.description: Normalizes bulk gene or protein expression matrices for downstream analysis.

skills.name: geo-search-api
skills.description: Searches NCBI GEO datasets and profiles by structured metadata.

skills.name: gsea
skills.description: Runs gene set enrichment analysis on a ranked gene list.

skills.name: lasso-logistics-analysis
skills.description: Builds binary classifiers with LASSO logistic regression and cross-validation.

skills.name: medical-research-algorithm-matcher
skills.description: Matches biomedical research objectives and data modalities to verified algorithms.

skills.name: medical-research-gap-finder
skills.description: Finds evidence-audited and study-ready gaps in biomedical research.

skills.name: medical-research-gap-to-study-planner
skills.description: Converts an audited research gap into an executable study plan.

skills.name: methods-section-writer
skills.description: Turns protocols and analysis workflows into publication-ready Methods text.

skills.name: multi-database-literature-collector
skills.description: Collects and normalizes verifiable biomedical literature across databases.

skills.name: novelty-vs-feasibility-assessor
skills.description: Balances research novelty against practical feasibility and evidence quality.

skills.name: pca-dimensionality-reduction
skills.description: Runs principal component analysis on tabular numeric data.

skills.name: primary-plan-recommender
skills.description: Compares study routes and recommends a primary biomedical research plan.

skills.name: reference-integrity-checker
skills.description: Checks whether manuscript references accurately support their associated claims.

skills.name: result-reliability-checker
skills.description: Audits study design, statistics, bias controls, validation, and claim discipline.

skills.name: results-section-writer
skills.description: Writes a structured biomedical Results section from verified outputs.

skills.name: topic-evidence-mapper
skills.description: Maps research streams, populations, endpoints, methods, and evidence density.

skills.name: validation-strategy-designer
skills.description: Designs internal, external, temporal, and functional validation strategies.

skills.name: wgcna-analysis
skills.description: Builds weighted gene co-expression networks from bulk expression matrices.
